messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ONCALL PAGE: GPU hotpool saturation detected for region-us-west-2. token-bucket throttles high, multiple 429s observed across low and medium tiers. Please acknowledge.
alex_oncall: acked. I'm looking at the dashboards now. queue length spiking on hotpath pools.
maria_sre: I see same — hotpool-gpu-eta-0 has all GPUs at 100% and pending queue > 12k. autoscaler shows repeated scale attempts failing with 'scale_limit_reached' errors.
jordan_runtime: logs show token bucket drops: "rate_exceeded" across tier 2 -> 5. Config looks like rate: 800/s burst: 1200 but effective tokens per-second is lower because we have per-route shards.
sarah_support: just got a DM from an enterprise customer (acme-corp) complaining about 429s in production, they reported 10x error rates starting ~10:22 UTC.
kyle_sales: flagged — ACME is hitting us while running inference on large batched requests, they want an ETA.
alex_oncall: initial mitigation plan: 1) reduce per-request concurrency by rolling a temporary route policy to lower per-conn tokens; 2) bump autoscaler max nodes; 3) open canary fallback to smaller model for high-latency traffic.
pm_rita: please include a short customer impact blurb for comms once we have concrete mitigation.
maria_sre: digging into autoscaler events: I see repeated failed attempts to attach new hotpool nodes — fail reason: insufficient GPU quota in zone and another error: "token_bucket_reservation_conflict" when assigning tier reservations.
jordan_runtime: that token_bucket_reservation_conflict rings a bell — we rolled a tier redistribution yesterday to reassign tokens to low-latency routes; might have a bug where reservation counters don't decrement on canceled allocations.
alex_oncall: can you dump the token bucket allocation table?
jordan_runtime: pasted below:```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","tier":"hot","allocated":640,"reserved":640,"limit":640}
{"route":"/v1/chat","tier":"hot","allocated":1280,"reserved":1400,"limit":1280}
{"route":"/v1/embed","tier":"warm","allocated":200,"reserved":200,"limit":200}
```
(just a quick snippet, looks inconsistent: reserved > limit on chat)
maria_sre: that explains the "reservation_conflict" — reserved counters exceeded limits so new allocations blocked, autoscaler still trying to add nodes but the request-level admission layer rejects requests leading to queue growth.
infra-bot: autoscaler: attempted scale from 40 -> 60 nodes at 10:23:12 UTC, result: partial_failure - 14 nodes created, 6 failed (quota), 0 pending.
alex_oncall: immediate steps: A) patch token bucket counters to forcibly reconcile reserved -> allocated for affected routes; B) temporarily relax token validation to allow overcommits while we stabilize; C) raise autoscaler ceiling for hotpool to +20 nodes if quota available in other AZs and failover possible.
maria_sre: I'll run a safe reconcile script to decrement stale reservations and force a reconcile. Command: `./tools/tbucket_reconcile --routes /v1/chat,/v1/generate --force` (running now).
jordan_runtime: I'm prepping a config patch to prevent reserved>limit on next deploy. Patch snippet:```yaml
token_buckets:
  reconcile_on_alloc_fail: true
  max_overcommit_pct: 10
  tiers:
    hot:
      rate_per_sec: 1200
      burst: 2400
```
alex_oncall: while reconcile runs, enable fallback routing: route 10% of traffic to `model-small` for tenants with high error rates. Sarah, can you list impacted tenants?
sarah_support: ACME, beta-analytics, platform-infra-runner all show error spikes. I've opened a ticket and notified ACME support.
kyle_sales: ACME wants priority queueing; can we offer immediate SLA workaround?
pm_rita: yes, give them a short blurb: "We're investigating a capacity and rate-limit incident affecting some inference requests. We're triaging and applying mitigations; we'll follow up within 30 mins with status and estimated remediation."
alex_oncall: reconcile finished — output: `reconciled: /v1/chat (-200 reserved), /v1/generate (-80 reserved). tokens freed: 280.` Queue length down to 4.2k. 429 rate decreased but still present.
jordan_runtime: rolling the config patch to staging, will promote to prod after quick smoke test (30s).
maria_sre: autoscaler report: now scaled to 54 nodes, GPUs at 80% avg. We hit a secondary issue: rate-tier routing still splits some traffic to overloaded AZ because of sticky route hashing. I'll flip routing to round-robin across healthy racks.
alex_oncall: do it. Also adjust token bucket per-tenant windows to reduce per-connection token debt. Proposed quick change: reduce `window_ms` from 1000 -> 500 for hot tier.
jordan_runtime: applied window change. Monitoring now shows token refill rate appears smoother, token queue backlog falling.
infra-bot: deploy: promoted token bucket config to prod at 10:40:02 UTC - deploy id: dep-2026-1142.
sarah_support: ACME acknowledged the message and appreciates the transparency. They're asking if this was a config mistake or traffic spike.
maria_sre: root cause appears to be twofold: 1) config bug allowing reserved counters to drift (yesterday tier redistribution); 2) a traffic spike from large-batch retries after a separate client-side timeout. We'll include both in postmortem.
alex_oncall: current status: 429 rate reduced to baseline for most tenants; ACME errors reduced to near-zero after fallback routing. Hotpool GPUs at 70% avg. We're keeping autoscaler ceiling +15 for next 2 hours.
kyle_sales: pinging ACME account owner with interim note.
pm_rita: please prepare an incident summary for later: customer impact, mitigations, timeline, follow-ups (deploy bugfix, add reconciliation cron, add quota fallback to other AZs).
jordan_runtime: open action items: 1) revert max_overcommit_pct to safe default after controlled test; 2) add unit test for reserved<=limit; 3) implement async reservation decrement on cancel; 4) gating tier redistribution behind canary.
maria_sre: scheduling a post-incident review 48h out. I'll attach logs and the reconcile script output.
alex_oncall: on-call handoff to maria in 30m. If anything spikes, @maria_sre please escalate to eng-sre channel.
maria_sre: ack — I'll take the next ops window.
incident-bot: incident ticket created INC-2026-4321, severity: high, start: 2476549876, assigned: SRE.
pm_rita: thanks all. I'll draft the customer-facing update and loop in legal for any contractual impact notes.
sarah_support: closing loop with ACME: "We've implemented mitigations (token bucket reconciliation, autoscaler adjustments, routing fallback). We're monitoring; will follow up with detailed postmortem." :thumbsup:
